events.content:
Implemented a complete reading-list app with:

- Separate “Currently reading” and “Finished” sections
- Add-book form with title, author, and optional notes
- One-click “Mark finished” action
- Individual book pages at `/books/:id`
- Copyable, shareable book links
- Persistent JSON storage in [data/books.json](/workspace/data/books.json)
- Responsive, accessible styling
- Atomic, serialized file writes to avoid corrupted or lost data

Run it with:

```bash
npm start
```

Then open `http://localhost:3000`.

Verification passed:

- 7 automated tests
- Syntax/build checks
- Add, detail, finish, and listing flows
- Direct book URLs
- Persistence across a real server restart

The main implementation is in [src/server.js](/workspace/src/server.js), [src/store.js](/workspace/src/store.js), and [public/app.js](/workspace/public/app.js).

Then open `http://localhost:3000`.
